recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Do not reintroduce FHIR-16335 wording; any future implicit-code-system work should proceed through later issues such as FHIR-40432 or linked successors.
issue_request: FHIR-16335 was Published/Persuasive with Modification for FHIR-core CodeSystem. It asked to mark the detailed metadata section informative and make it less specific because the RxNorm/LOINC separate detail-resource guidance was confusing.
initial_application: Commit 1997a01d8577f30f5d3623567efbad30292eed53 (svn r14659, GF#16335) wrapped the section in informative content and revised the examples to Medication resource instances for RxNorm, ObservationDefinition instances for LOINC, and Location. Commit 4907f9bcb0b710cb2837a93a20c4b23210a37249 later moved the same material under a draft/informative Implicit Code Systems section while retaining the detail-resource guidance.
additional_context: FHIR-39265 later targeted codesystem.html#detailed-metadata and resolved to remove the Implicit Code System section because the text was confusing and not clearly about implicit code systems; commit 5b5b4bd9e5cd01b766e91cc133cbd49ed7b2dcae commented it out. FHIR-40432 then restored a rewritten Implicit Code Systems section in commit b43da92ce17ba143a684e32b04edfd5b18d82ecd, without restoring the old RxNorm/LOINC separate-detail-resource prose. FHIR-40432 is already represented on the combined branch.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. The latest combined-branch CodeSystem source has source/codesystem/codesystem-notes.xml:630 as the rewritten implicit-code-systems anchor, and grep finds no current non-history source match for the old detailed-metadata anchor or detail-resource guidance.

related_jiras.note: Published R5 CodeSystem issue that removed the detailed-metadata/Implicit Code Systems section after finding it confusing and insufficiently tied to implicit code systems.
Applied R6 issue that restored a rewritten Implicit Code Systems section without restoring the old RxNorm/LOINC detail-resource prose; it already has a combined-branch reconciliation commit.
